title: PolicyResponse
description: GET /api/v2/policy 200 body. Closed. Members match the GET /api/v1/policy success JSON (version, mode, stopped, customRules, archiveUpload, githubUpload, overrides, exemptions, engineRevision) plus rulesHash. overrides and exemptions are omitted by v1 JSON.stringify when undefined, so they are not required. Not a frozen protocol. This package does not implement the route.

mode.description: v1 returns policy.mode, or off when policy.stopped is true.

customRules.description: 沿用 v1 customRules 形状，本包不重新建模。

archiveUpload.description: 沿用 v1 archivePolicy() 形状，本包不重新建模。

githubUpload.description: 沿用 v1 githubPolicy() 形状，本包不重新建模。

overrides.description: 沿用 v1 policy.overrides 形状，本包不重新建模。

exemptions.description: 沿用 v1 policy.exemptions 形状，本包不重新建模。

rulesHash.description: sha256: plus the 64 lowercase hex digits from the same calculation as policy history rulesHash (policyRulesHash).

v1Object.description: 沿用 v1 形状，本包不重新建模。
